default.notes: A visa must be obtained in advance — apply at a Namibian diplomatic mission, or through the Ministry of Home Affairs eServices portal where online applications are accepted for your nationality.

groups.notes: SADC citizens enter Namibia visa-free — visits of up to 90 days per calendar year.

Since 1 April 2025 Namibia requires a visa from previously-exempt countries that do not reciprocate its waiver — issued on arrival at airports and major land borders (or online in advance) for NAD 1,600 (about USD 90), for stays of up to 90 days.
Visa-free under a reciprocal arrangement — typically up to 90 days; Namibia's exemption lists are under review, so confirm before travel.

NA.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Namibian citizens.
